query: EVALUATE ROW("Dự án", CONCATENATEX(VALUES('F_HR'[Project Name]), IF(ISBLANK('F_HR'[Project Name]), "(Blank)", 'F_HR'[Project Name]), ", "), "Kênh", CONCATENATEX(VALUES('F_HR'[Channel]), IF(ISBLANK('F_HR'[Channel]), "(Blank)", 'F_HR'[Channel]), ", "), "Tháng", CONCATENATEX(VALUES('D_Date'[Month]), IF(ISBLANK('D_Date'[Month]), "(Blank)", FORMAT('D_Date'[Month], "0")), ", ", 'D_Date'[Month], ASC))
